original.out:
usage: tally [-h] [--version] {add,show,undo} ...

Count things from the command line.

positional arguments:
  {add,show,undo}
    add            add to a count
    show           show every total
    undo           cancel the latest add

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --version        show program's version number and exit

cshort.out:
usage: tally [-h] [--version] {add,show,undo} ...

Count named things in an append-only ledger.

positional arguments:
  {add,show,undo}
    add            add N to the count called NAME
    show           print every total
    undo           cancel the latest add that has not been undone

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --version        show program's version number and exit
